verdict.rationale: Omnara documents Skills that package reusable instructions and optional supporting files for agents, so conventions could be supplied as instructions. Separately, documents can be attached to a conversation. However, no evidence shows a dedicated repo-level context file (such as an AGENTS.md-style conventions file) that is loaded automatically to shape plans and code. Missing for 10: a documented codebase-conventions context file, automatic loading of repo context into agent planning, and any hands-on evidence that this improves plan or code relevance.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a context file describing my codebase conventions so agents generate more relevant plans and code

citations.quote: A skill packages reusable instructions and optional files for agents.
Skills let you package instructions and supporting files for work your agents do regularly.
You can also attach images and documents to a conversation.
